name: session-band
description: Prompt cache countdown, session cost, rate limits and context window usage in the band above the prompt

cacheTtl.title: Prompt cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: The cache TTL your main thread uses; the plugin cannot read it from the engine

showCost.title: Show session cost
showCost.description: Show the session's API-priced cost; on a subscription it is not what you are billed

showCredits.title: Show usage credits
showCredits.description: On credit-billed plans such as Enterprise, ask Claude's usage endpoint every 5 minutes, sooner after a failed request, for the monthly credit spend and show it under Limits; uses your own login, and the endpoint is undocumented
